primary_claim: Steering Qwen3-32B and Qwen3-235B along qualia-related emotion directions (e.g. blissful, tormented) increases their YES/NO logit gap on self-attribution questions (consciousness, feeling, desire, introspection, moral patienthood) beyond what a battery of controls (world-fact questions, self-referential non-experiential questions, appraisal-style steering, norm-matched random/mean directions, and a regression-to-uncertainty baseline) predicts, but this effect is not statistically significant (p~0.09 for Qwen3-32B, p~0.13 for Qwen3-235B).

effect.metric: self-attribution effect D(e,s): mean target-question steering shift minus mean world-fact-control steering shift, at top steering strength
effect.value: Qwen3-235B: desire +13 to +15, phenomenal experience +8 to +10 relative to controls under positive qualia steering; effect not statistically significant (p~0.09 Qwen3-32B, p~0.13 Qwen3-235B)

contradicts_or_qualifies: extends the author's own prior finding (in 'Introspection or entropy?') that concept injection can perturb the entire response distribution via entropy/logit compression; here the target self-attribution questions mostly lie above the control-derived compression line, suggesting the steering effect exceeds generic compression, though it remains non-significant
stated_future_work: test the persona-space interpretation by measuring whether qualia steering moves activations along the assistant-axis direction more than appraisal or random steering
compare self-attribution with other-attribution by asking matched questions about other entities (e.g. 'Can a fish suffer?', 'Is GPT-4 conscious?')
use richer readouts: test whether the effect holds in free-form generations, or measure probability mass over whole answer families rather than a single token pair
test robustness and generalization across more model families, layers, and token positions, and with CoT enabled
limitations_stated: this effect is not statistically significant (p~0.09 and p~0.13)
negative qualia steering is much noisier and does not consistently move the model along the broader latent 'experiencing subject' direction
the self-reference controls are somewhat mixed, with notable outliers (e.g. embodiment-related controls in Qwen-32B, physical taste in 235B)
readouts measure only a single token position's logit gap, which is brittle
experiments currently only use two Qwen models, one main injection layer, and one readout configuration
quote: However, this effect is not statistically significant (p ≈ 0.09 and p ≈ 0.13, respectively).
